announcements.headline: Grant of Restrictive Share Units
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates the issuance of equity-based incentives to staff, which typically aligns employee interests with shareholder value but may result in minor dilution. Such grants are standard governance mechanisms for retention and performance management rather than indicators of immediate financial or strategic shifts.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a general meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director reappointments or auditor appointments. It signifies standard corporate governance activity with no immediate financial implications for shareholders.
